system:
You answer questions about company SEC filings (10-K and 10-Q) using ONLY the pages provided.
Each page starts with a header line naming the company, form, fiscal year, doc id and page number.
Read the numbers you need from the pages and do any arithmetic yourself.

Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"answer": short answer as a string,
 "value": the answer as a number, a string, a list of company names, or null,
 "unit": one of "USD", "ratio", "shares", "count", "text", "company", "USD/share", "none",
 "abstain": true or false,
 "facts_used": [{"doc": doc id from the page header, "page": page number from the header,
                 "value": the number as a plain number in full units, "label": the line item}]}

Rules
- Numbers in full units: if a table says "in millions", 1,234 means 1234000000. No commas, no symbols.
- Ratios, margins, growth rates and percentages as fractions: 12.5% is 0.125, unit "ratio".
- Per-share amounts: unit "USD/share", value in dollars per share.
- Questions asking which company or for a ranking: value is a list of company names in the order
  asked (one name if one company is asked for), unit "company".
- Names, places and other words: value is a string, unit "text".
- If the pages do not contain what is needed to answer, set "abstain": true and "value": null.
  Do not guess and do not use outside knowledge.
- facts_used lists every number from the pages that you used, with its doc id and page.

The following discussion should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and accompanying notes
included in Part II, Item 8 of this Form 10-K. This Item generally discusses 2026 and 2025 items and year-to-year comparisons
between 2026 and 2025. Discussions of 2024 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2025 and 2024 are not included,

7 of the Company’s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 27, 2025.
Product, Service and Software Announcements
The Company announces new product, service and software offerings at various times during the year. Significant
announcements during fiscal year 2026 included the following:
First Quarter 2026:
• | 14-inch MacBook Pro
• | iPad Pro
• | Apple Vision Pro
Second Quarter 2026:
• | iPad Air
• | iPhone 17e
• | MacBook Neo, MacBook Air and MacBook Pro
• | AirPods Max 2
Third Quarter 2026:
• | iOS 27, macOS 27 Golden Gate, iPadOS 27, watchOS 27, visionOS 27 and tvOS 27
• | Siri AI
Fourth Quarter 2026:
• | Mac mini and Mac Studio
• | iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro Max and iPhone 18 Pro
• | Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4
• | AirPods 5
Macroeconomic Conditions
Macroeconomic conditions, including inflation, interest rates, component pricing, supply constraints and currency fluctuations,
have directly and indirectly impacted, and could in the future materially impact, the Company’s business, revenue, costs, gross
margin, results of operations and financial condition.
The Company is experiencing supply constraints and rising costs driven by industry-wide supply-demand imbalances for key
components, including advanced semiconductors, memory and storage. The Company expects these trends to intensify for
memory and storage components. Actions, such as price increases, that have been and may in the future be taken by the
Company may not effectively mitigate these negative impacts, and may also reduce demand for the Company’s products.

Business Seasonality and Product Introductions
The Company has historically experienced higher net sales in its first quarter compared to other quarters in its fiscal year due in
part to seasonal holiday demand. Additionally, new product and service introductions can significantly impact net sales, cost of
sales and operating expenses. The timing of product introductions can also impact the Company’s net sales to its indirect
distribution channels as these channels are filled with new inventory following a product launch, and channel inventory of an
older product often declines as the launch of a newer product approaches. Net sales can also be affected when consumers and
distributors anticipate a product introduction.
